summary: The case "" branch in newSearchCmd's switch never called db.Search(), leaving results nil for every plain search invocation without --type.
reason: The generated code initialized a seen deduplication map in the default (no --type) case and then did nothing with it — results was never populated. Only the default branch, reached when --type has a non-empty value, called db.Search(). Fixed by calling db.Search(query, limit) in case "" so that unfiltered searches return actual FTS results.
